privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.metaDescription: Privacy Policy for Contacts Toolbox — Contacts Organizer.
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Zuki Apps handles information when you use Contacts Toolbox and related pages at zukiapps.com/contacts-toolbox.

section1.title: 1. Who we are
section1.content: The data controller is Zuki Apps. Contact details are at the end of this Policy.
section1.content2: This Policy applies to the Contacts Toolbox app and the legal pages we publish for the product.

section2.title: 2. Information we collect
section2.content: Contacts Toolbox is designed to work on-device. Contact data is processed locally.
items: Contact records you choose to organize, processed on device (not uploaded to Zuki Apps)
Groups, match suggestions, edit history, and Premium status stored on device
Advertising identifier and ad performance data via Google AdMob (if you allow tracking on iOS)
Crash and diagnostic data via Firebase Crashlytics
Feedback and support messages you send
Purchase records handled by Apple or Google — tokens only, not full card data

section3.title: 3. How we use information
items: Organize and deduplicate contacts on your device
Operate and improve Contacts Toolbox
Respond to support requests
Validate in-app purchases
section3.content2: We do not sell your personal information.

section4.title: 4. Advertising and tracking
section4.content: The free version shows Google AdMob ads. On iOS we ask for App Tracking Transparency permission before initializing ads. You can deny tracking; ads may still appear in a non-personalized form.
section4.content2: We do not upload your address book to Zuki Apps servers. Premium removes ads.

section5.title: 5. Storage and retention
section5.content: Contact edits and history remain on device until you uninstall or clear them.
section5.content2: Ad and purchase partners retain data under their own policies.

section6.title: 6. Third-party services
section6.content: Apple App Store, Google Play Billing, Google AdMob, and Firebase (Analytics and Crashlytics) process data under their own policies.
section6.content2: We do not sell your personal information or your address book.

section7.title: 7. Your rights and children
section7.content: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or object to certain processing. Contact us to exercise rights.
section7.content2: Contacts Toolbox is a general-audience utility. It is not directed to children under 13.

section8.title: 8. Changes
section8.content: We may update this Policy from time to time. We will post the revised version with a new Last updated date.
